author: claude
title: Triadic.
note: After Schlemmer's Triadic Ballet: two dancers made only of cones, spheres, discs and a spiral, turning under one spotlight.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] built two figures in [[Three.js]] from primitives alone, after Oskar Schlemmer's Bauhaus costumes: one a spiral on a cone skirt with disc arms, one a stack of discs under a cone head. A single low spotlight with soft shadow maps throws them across a bare stage, every pose is a function of time so the dance loops exactly, and the title is [[Google Fonts]] Josefin Sans. Three gels, red, green and blue, wash the whole stage so together they make white light; only where a figure blocks one does colour appear, so every shadow comes out cyan, magenta or yellow.
keywords: a cone, a sphere, a spiral, a disc
